'''Novaplex''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide luxury [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] chain, owners of the "Imperial" line. They also dealt in apartment rentals and resorts. Novaplex was one of the original [[contributing sponsor]]s to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], and was upgraded to a [[voting sponsor]].<ref name="HSCS" /> Novaplex also manufactured security apparatus, including [[monofilament screen guard]]s.<ref name="GFT" />
